topic.title: Topic
topic.description: The article topic. Can be broad (e.g., 'newborn sleep') or specific (e.g., 'diaper rash prevention').

language.title: Language
language.description: Output language. Use 'en' for English or 'th' for Thai.

age_range.title: Child age range (optional)
age_range.description: Optional child age range to tailor the article. If null or omitted, write generally and include brief age notes.

min.description: Minimum age in the chosen unit.

max.description: Maximum age in the chosen unit. Must be >= min.

article_style.title: Article style
article_style.description: High-level writing style / structure. Use 'how_to_guide' for step-by-step guidance, or choose another style if it fits the topic.

word_count.title: Maximum words (optional)
word_count.description: If provided, the article must not exceed this word count. Overrides length preset guidance.

include_checklist.title: Include checklist
include_checklist.description: Whether to include a practical checklist section.

include_red_flags.title: Include red flags
include_red_flags.description: Whether to include a 'red flags / when to seek care' section (strongly recommended).

output_format.title: Output format (standard article only)
output_format.description: Preferred format for standard article mode. If response_mode='json', this setting is ignored.

response_mode.title: Response mode
response_mode.description: Choose the output mode: a standard human-readable article or a structured JSON object.

show_references.title: Show references
show_references.description: Whether to include a short references section (non-clickable titles/domains).
